chemical_life_science_product_family.label: Chemical / life-science product family
chemical_life_science_product_family.value: Rare-disease medicines for achondroplasia, lysosomal storage diseases and other inherited metabolic conditions.

specialty_commodity_positioning.value: Specialty medicines for genetically defined rare diseases, designed to be first to market or offer substantial benefit over existing therapies.

formulation_synthesis_complexity.label: Formulation / synthesis complexity
formulation_synthesis_complexity.value: Specialized biologics manufacturing for therapeutic enzymes.
